label: Recipient capacity and participation remain separate from scale calibration
summary: On the shared GradesFrame, a fully calibrated finite linear scale leaves the recipient capacity bridge open, even with each bearer self-limited. A product-order model separates capacity comparability from the within-capacity interpretation of limitation. A distinct cause, participating bearer and cross-recipient coexist with the same linear scale while the three causal/reception links fail, using explicitly assigned predicates. The models test formal non-entailment only. The existing scope and source judgments are retained. See docs/notes/maximum-definition-fork.md#capacity-reception-and-participation-in-the-same-comparison-domain.
blocker: The cause–effect role needs warrant for the inference from lying within the effect's capacity to actual limitation by that effect. The participation-to-reception application also needs the edition-level In De hebdomadibus witness and an interpretation of its reception modes, as recorded in PR #2024.
